-- Single source for treadmill tiers, access requirements and model assignments.
local Config = {}
Config.PremiumTreadmillPassId = 1982996954 -- Administrator Treadmill
Config.Types = {
 Normal = {Multiplier=1, RequiredRebirth=0, VisualTemplate=""},
	Rebirth3 = {Multiplier=2, RequiredRebirth=3, VisualTemplate="Blue_Aura4"},
	Rebirth7 = {Multiplier=3, RequiredRebirth=5, VisualTemplate="Green_Aura2"},
 Premium = {Multiplier=7, RequiresPremium=true, VisualTemplate="Premium_Fire", VisualInstanceName="PremiumAura"},
}
-- Purchased visual names map to the existing authoritative strength tiers.
Config.Assignments = {
 Normal01="Normal", Normal02="Normal",
 Iron01="Rebirth3", Iron02="Rebirth3",
 Gold01="Rebirth7", Gold02="Rebirth7",
 Diamond01="Premium",
}
-- Presentation uses the same authoritative Multiplier that TrainingManager awards.
Config.StrengthColors = {
 [2] = {
  BeltColor = Color3.fromRGB(55, 145, 255),
  FrameColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 65, 150),
  MatColor = Color3.fromRGB(8, 25, 65),
 },
 [3] = {
  BeltColor = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 110),
  FrameColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 100, 55),
  MatColor = Color3.fromRGB(8, 40, 22),
 },
}
-- Additional group guidance; existing per-machine signs are independent.
Config.MultiplierBillboard = {
 MaxDistance = 80,
 StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), -- World-space offset above existing signs.
 Size = Vector2.new(16, 10), -- World-space studs at TextScale=1.
 TextScale = 1.5,
}
-- Shared World1/World2 station headings; existing artwork and fonts are reused.
Config.StationHeading = {
 Size = Vector2.new(16, 6),
 GroupGap = 0.06, -- Vertical separation between the requirement and gain rows.
 RequirementWidth = 0.42,
 PremiumRequirementWidth = 0.60,
 MultiplierWidth = 0.94,
 IconGap = 0.035, -- Relative to the compact requirement group.
 RowHeight = 0.42,
 World2Offset = Vector3.new(0, 7.35, 0),
}
-- Stud units; edit in Studio and restart Play to tune the moving chevrons.
Config.Guide = {
 Enabled = true,
 Speed = 4,
 Transparency = 0.15,
 Size = Vector2.new(4, 1.6),
 Spacing = 4,
 Thickness = 0.25,
 NormalColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255),
 BlueColor = Color3.fromRGB(205, 240, 255),
 GreenColor = Color3.fromRGB(215, 255, 225),
 PremiumColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 185),
}
function Config.Get(modelName)
 local kind=Config.Assignments[modelName]
 return kind and Config.Types[kind],kind
end
function Config.GetStrengthColors(modelName)
 local entry=Config.Get(modelName)
 return entry and Config.StrengthColors[entry.Multiplier]
end
function Config.GetStrengthColor(modelName)
 local colors=Config.GetStrengthColors(modelName)
 return colors and colors.BeltColor
end
function Config.GetDisplayText(modelName)
 local entry,kind=Config.Get(modelName)
 if not entry then return "Unavailable" end
 local title=kind=="Premium" and "PREMIUM" or (kind=="Normal" and "NORMAL" or "TRAINING")
 local requirement=entry.RequiredRebirth and entry.RequiredRebirth>0
  and ("\nRebirth "..entry.RequiredRebirth.." Required") or ""
 return title.."\n�~"..tostring(entry.Multiplier)..requirement
end

-- Shared station text, also used by the existing left-menu localization refresh.
function Config.GetGainDisplayText(modelName,localeId)
 local entry=Config.Get(modelName)
 if not entry then return nil end
 return "�~"..tostring(entry.Multiplier).." Strength"
end

-- Only the seven existing, exact World2 roots authorize World2 training.
local World2=require(script.Parent.World2GameplayConfig)
local stationTypes={1,1,2,2,3,3,4}
function Config.GetPremiumTreadmillPassId(world)
 return world==2 and World2.Treadmills[4].GamePassId or Config.PremiumTreadmillPassId
end
function Config.WorldForModel(model)
 if not model then return nil end
 if model.Parent==workspace:FindFirstChild("Treadmills") and Config.Get(model.Name) then return 1 end
 local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("World2Map")
 local area=map and map:FindFirstChild("TrainingArea")
 local folder=area and area:FindFirstChild("TreadmillDisplays")
 local index=tonumber(model.Name)
 if folder and model.Parent==folder and index and model.Name==string.format("%02d",index) and stationTypes[index] then return 2 end
end
function Config.GetForModel(model)
 local world=Config.WorldForModel(model)
 if world==1 then return Config.Get(model.Name) end
 if world==2 then
  local index=stationTypes[tonumber(model.Name)]
  return World2.Treadmills[index],"World2_"..index
 end
end
return Config

-- Shared geometry and bounded longitudinal motion. No progression writes.
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.World1WalkwayConfig)
local ArrowGeometry=require(script.Parent.FloorArrowGeometry)
local arrowHalfWidth=ArrowGeometry.Dimensions(Config.WidthMultiplier).Width/2
local M={}
function M.Bounds(route,character)
 return Config.StartDistance,M.EndDistance(route,character)-Config.EndpointTolerance,arrowHalfWidth
end
function M.Contains(route,along,side,bodyEnd)
 local first,last,halfWidth=M.Bounds(route)
 if bodyEnd then last=math.min(last,bodyEnd-Config.EndpointTolerance) end
 return along>=first and along<last and math.abs(side)<=halfWidth
end
function M.new()
 local owner,stageOwner,sectionOwner,floorOwner
 local wallLocal,wallSize
 return function()
  local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("GeneratedMap")
  local lobby=map and map:FindFirstChild("TrainingArea")
  local spawn=lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation")
  local floor=lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("Floor")
  local corridor=map and map:FindFirstChild("BattleCorridor")
  local stage=corridor and corridor:FindFirstChild("Stage01")
  local section=stage and stage:FindFirstChild("Stage1.1")
  if map~=owner or stage~=stageOwner or section~=sectionOwner or floor~=floorOwner then
   owner,stageOwner,sectionOwner,floorOwner=map,stage,section,floor
   wallLocal,wallSize=nil,nil
  end
  if not spawn or not spawn:IsA("BasePart") or not floor or not floor:IsA("BasePart")
   or not floor.Anchored or not floor.CanCollide or not stage or not section then return end
  local wall=section:FindFirstChild("Wall")
  if wall and wall:IsA("BasePart") then
   wallLocal=floor.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(wall.CFrame);wallSize=wall.Size
  end
  -- The first wall's structural reference survives personal wall destruction.
  if not wallLocal then return end
  local cf=floor.CFrame*wallLocal
  local delta=Vector3.new(cf.X-spawn.Position.X,0,cf.Z-spawn.Position.Z)
  if delta.Magnitude<.01 then return end
  local direction=delta.Unit
  local localDirection=cf:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
  local face=math.huge
  for _,axis in {"X","Y","Z"} do
   if math.abs(localDirection[axis])>1e-5 then face=math.min(face,wallSize[axis]/(2*math.abs(localDirection[axis]))) end
  end
  return {Origin=spawn.Position,Direction=direction,Side=direction:Cross(Vector3.yAxis),
   WallDistance=delta.Magnitude-face,Map=map,Lobby=lobby,Stage=stage,Section=section,Floor=floor}
 end
end
function M.IsFloor(part,route)
 if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Anchored or not part.CanCollide then return false end
 if part==route.Floor then return true end
 local parent=part.Parent
 if parent==route.Map:FindFirstChild("LobbyCorridorConnector") then return part.Name=="ConnectorFloor" end
 if part.Name=="Floor" and (parent==route.Stage or parent==route.Section or parent==route.Stage:FindFirstChild("WalkableGeometry")) then return true end
 if part.Name~="Upper" and part.Name~="Lower" then return false end
 local entrance=route.Lobby:FindFirstChild("EntranceCarpets")
 if parent==entrance then return true end
 if parent and (parent.Name=="Path" or parent.Name=="PathToRun") then
  return parent.Parent==entrance or parent.Parent==route.Stage:FindFirstChild("WalkableGeometry") or parent.Parent==route.Section
 end
 return false
end
function M.Coordinates(route,position)
 local delta=position-route.Origin
 return delta:Dot(route.Direction),delta:Dot(route.Side)
end
function M.TransportVelocity(walkSpeed,input,remaining,dt)
 -- Input is only the wall-axis projection of normal movement (-1..1).
 -- Recompute from intent every step; never add to last frame's velocity.
 local walking=walkSpeed*math.clamp(input,-1,1)
 local stoppingSpeed=math.max(0,remaining/math.max(dt*2,.08))
 local velocity=math.min(Config.TransportSpeed+walking,stoppingSpeed)
 return velocity,math.max(0,velocity-walking)
end
function M.EndDistance(route,character)
 -- Stop the physical body before the wall even for large/custom body sizes.
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local extent=0
 if root then for _,part in character:GetChildren() do
  if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" then
   local cf=part.CFrame;local half=part.Size/2;local d=route.Direction
   extent=math.max(extent,(part.Position-root.Position):Dot(d)+math.abs(cf.RightVector:Dot(d))*half.X
    +math.abs(cf.UpVector:Dot(d))*half.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector:Dot(d))*half.Z)
  end
 end end
 return route.WallDistance-math.max(Config.EndClearance,extent+.5)
end
function M.Grounded(character,humanoid,root,route,params)
 local state=humanoid:GetState()
 if humanoid.Health<=0 or root.Anchored or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.Jump
  or (state~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running and state~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics and state~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
  or math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)>3 then return false end
 local standing=humanoid.HipHeight+root.Size.Y/2
 if humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
  local leg=character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg");standing+=leg and leg.Size.Y or 0
 end
 -- First actual collision below the character must be an authored walking floor.
 -- FloorMaterial is not authoritative on a server with client-owned avatars.
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-standing-Config.GroundTolerance,0),params)
 if not hit or not M.IsFloor(hit.Instance,route) or hit.Normal.Y<.7 then return false end
 if math.abs(hit.Distance-standing)<=Config.GroundTolerance then return true end
 -- Also inspect real foot soles: custom scaled rigs need not have a fixed Root Y.
 for _,name in {"LeftFoot","RightFoot","Left Leg","Right Leg"} do
  local foot=character:FindFirstChild(name)
  if foot and foot:IsA("BasePart") then
   local cf=foot.CFrame
   local halfY=(math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*foot.Size.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*foot.Size.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*foot.Size.Z)/2
   local sole=foot.Position-Vector3.yAxis*halfY
   local footHit=workspace:Raycast(sole+Vector3.yAxis*.1,-Vector3.yAxis*(Config.GroundTolerance+.1),params)
   if footHit and M.IsFloor(footHit.Instance,route) and footHit.Normal.Y>=.7 then return true end
  end
 end
 return false
end
return M

local Responsive=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ResponsivePanels)
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config=require(RS.Config:WaitForChild("DailyRewardConfig"))
local RewardDisplay=require(RS.Modules:WaitForChild("RewardDisplay"))
local gui=script.Parent
local panel=gui:WaitForChild("DailyRewardsPanel")
local menu=gui:WaitForChild("LeftMenu")
local request=RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("DailyRewardClaim")
local stateRemote=RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("DailyRewardState")
local ShopConfig=require(RS.Config.ShopProductConfig)
local vip=panel.Holder:WaitForChild("VIPBonus")
local snapshot,pending
local CLAIMED_GRADIENT=ColorSequence.new({
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(116,110,132)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(154,149,168)),
})
local originalButtonVisuals=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function setClaimedVisual(button,claimed)
 local gradient=button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
 local outer=button:FindFirstChild("UIStroke")
 local inner=button:FindFirstChild("UIStrokeInner")
 local original=originalButtonVisuals[button]
 if not original then
  original={BackgroundColor3=button.BackgroundColor3,GradientColor=gradient and gradient.Color,OuterColor=outer and outer.Color,InnerColor=inner and inner.Color}
  originalButtonVisuals[button]=original
 end
 button.BackgroundColor3=claimed and Color3.fromRGB(138,133,150) or original.BackgroundColor3
 if gradient then gradient.Color=claimed and CLAIMED_GRADIENT or original.GradientColor end
 if outer then outer.Color=claimed and Color3.fromRGB(61,58,69) or original.OuterColor end
 if inner then inner.Color=claimed and Color3.fromRGB(210,207,218) or original.InnerColor end
end
local function render()
 local state=snapshot and snapshot.States and snapshot.States.VIP or "Locked"
 vip.RewardText.Text=RewardDisplay.GetText(ShopConfig.Get("VIP").DailyBonus)
 vip.DayText.Text="VIP • Daily bonus"
 vip.Locked.Visible=state=="Locked"
 vip.Locked.TextLabel.Text="VIP ONLY"
 vip.Redeem.Visible=not vip.Locked.Visible
 vip.Redeem.Active=state=="Ready" and pending==nil
 vip.Redeem.AutoButtonColor=vip.Redeem.Active
 setClaimedVisual(vip.Redeem,state=="Claimed")
 vip.Redeem.TextLabel.Text=state=="Claimed" and "CLAIMED" or pending=="VIP" and "SAVING..." or "CLAIM"
 menu.DailyRewardsButton.NotificationBadge.Visible=snapshot~=nil and snapshot.Loaded==true and snapshot.HasReady==true
 for day,reward in ipairs(Config.Rewards) do
  local card=panel.Holder["Day"..day]
  local state=snapshot and snapshot.States and snapshot.States["Day"..day] or "Locked"
  local ready=snapshot and snapshot.Loaded and state=="Ready"
  card.RewardText.Text=RewardDisplay.GetText(reward)
  card.DayText.Text="Day "..day..(ready and " • READY" or "")
  card.Locked.Visible=state=="Locked" or state=="Failed"
  card.Redeem.Visible=not card.Locked.Visible
  card.Redeem.Active=ready==true and pending==nil
  card.Redeem.AutoButtonColor=card.Redeem.Active
  setClaimedVisual(card.Redeem,state=="Claimed")
  card.Redeem.TextLabel.Text=state=="Claimed" and "CLAIMED" or (state=="Pending" and "SAVING..." or "CLAIM")
  card.Locked.TextLabel.Text=state=="Failed" and "ERROR" or "LOCKED"
 end
end
local function refresh()
 local ok,state=pcall(function() return stateRemote:InvokeServer() end)
 if ok and typeof(state)=="table" then snapshot=state end
 render()
end
for day=1,Config.GetDayCount() do
 Responsive.ConnectActivation(panel.Holder["Day"..day].Redeem,function()
  if pending or not snapshot or not snapshot.States or snapshot.States["Day"..day]~="Ready" then return end
  pending=day request:FireServer(day) render()
  task.delay(5,function() if pending==day then pending=nil;refresh() end end)
 end)
end
Responsive.ConnectActivation(vip.Redeem,function()
 if pending or not snapshot or not snapshot.States or snapshot.States.VIP~="Ready" then return end
 pending="VIP";request:FireServer("VIP");render()
 task.delay(5,function()if pending=="VIP" then pending=nil;refresh()end end)
end)
request.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result)
 if typeof(result)~="table" then return end
 if typeof(result.State)=="table" then snapshot=result.State end
 if result.Code then pending=nil end
 render()
end)
local function layout()
 require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ResponsivePanels).Fit(panel,gui)
end
menu.DailyRewardsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
 panel.Visible=not panel.Visible
 if panel.Visible then
  for _,name in ipairs({"TimeRewardsPanel","InventoryPanel","ShopPanel","RebirthPanel","MergePanel"}) do
   local other=gui:FindFirstChild(name) if other then other.Visible=false end
  end
  refresh()
 end
end)
Responsive.ConnectActivation(panel.Top.Close,function() panel.Visible=false end)
for _,name in ipairs({"TimeRewardsButton","InventoryButton","ShopButton","RebirthButton","MergeButton","SkipButton"}) do
 local button=menu:FindFirstChild(name)
 if button then button.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible=false end) end
end
local function order()
 task.defer(function()
  gui.DisplayOrder=(panel.Visible or gui.TimeRewardsPanel.Visible) and 26 or 10
 end)
end
panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(order)
gui.TimeRewardsPanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(order)
gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout)
layout() order() render() task.spawn(refresh)

-- Permanent World1 navigation. Independent of Character/HUD/tutorial readiness.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local SETTINGS=require(RS:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("World1WalkwayConfig"))
local Geometry=require(RS.Modules:WaitForChild("World1WalkwayGeometry"))
local resolve=Geometry.new()
local renderer=require(RS.Modules:WaitForChild("FloorGuideRenderer")).new({
 Name="World1PermanentFloorGuide",Fixed=true,Owner=script,
 WidthMultiplier=SETTINGS.WidthMultiplier,Transparency=SETTINGS.Transparency,
 FlowSpeed=SETTINGS.ArrowSpeed,Spacing=SETTINGS.ArrowSpacing,SurfaceSampleStep=SETTINGS.SurfaceSampleStep,
})
local pending
local connections={}
local function refresh()
 if not renderer:IsAlive() then return end
 if (player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") or 1)~=1 then
  renderer:Hide();renderer:StopCache();return
 end
 local route=resolve()
 if not route then renderer:Hide();return end
 local first,last=Geometry.Bounds(route,player.Character)
 -- Every circulating arrow stays inside the continuous transport corridor.
 -- Keep the authored 5-stud entrance and wall/body stopping clearance.
 renderer:Show("World1SpawnToFirstWall",route.Origin+route.Direction*first,
  route.Origin+route.Direction*last)
end
local function tick()
 pending=nil
 if not renderer:IsAlive() then return end
 refresh()
 pending=task.delay(SETTINGS.RefreshInterval,tick)
end
renderer.OnDestroy=function()
 if pending then task.cancel(pending);pending=nil end
 for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
 table.clear(connections)
end
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CurrentWorld"):Connect(refresh))
table.insert(connections,script.Destroying:Once(function() renderer:Destroy() end))
-- Deferred work cannot hold up character loading, movement or another LocalScript.
pending=task.defer(tick)
